messages:
Maya R.: Quick sync — Q3 launch readiness. Feature work for Search-ReRank is at 80% but we also have a growing SLO backlog (p99 latency & occasional error spikes). Need a prioritization decision: push feature to hit customer commitments or timebox SLO debt first? @Samir K. @Alex C. @Jia P. @Lena S.

Samir K.: RICE helps here. Quick stab: feature R:8 I:7 C:3 E:5 => 93. SLO fixes: R:6 I:6 C:2 E:4 => 72. Numbers favor feature but risk profile is higher if we ignore the p99 flapping. My pragmatic pick: reserve a fixed sprint slice (25–30%) for the top SLO work so we don't accumulate more debt.

Alex C.: Agree with reserving capacity. Also proposal: ship the re-rank behind a flag + 2% canary in prod, with automatic rollback threshold on p99 latency and error rate. That lets CS give tentative dates to customers while protecting SLOs. Also suggest a timeboxed 24–48h spike to clear the top 3 SLO causes (root cause + quick fixes).

Jia P.: From CS: Customer-3 is pushing for the re-rank — they want it in the next release for a contract milestone. They also asked for an availability commitment. If we do a canary + feature flag, we can offer a controlled rollout but need eng signoff on fallback.

Lena S.: Ops note — current SLO burn rate is trending up; last week we saw two regressions after a small infra change. If we add re-rank at scale, p99 could move more than expected. Suggestions: (1) reduce feature surface at launch (skip heavy rerank in tail queries), (2) add circuit-breaker on the rerank path, (3) make the canary autoscale limit conservative.

ops-bot: ALERT: gen-latency-p99 breached 2025-11-09T09:20:31Z — rolling window 5m above threshold. Paging on-call.

Maya R.: Decision proposal: 1) Proceed with feature behind flag + 2% canary. 2) Reserve 30% of sprint capacity for SLO work (Samir owner). 3) Run 48h SLO spike to clear top 3 issues (Samir + Alex). 4) Launch scope trimmed (no tail rerank) and circuit-breaker enabled (Lena owner). Jia to notify Customer-3 that we have a controlled rollout plan. If no objections by EOD, I'll put this into the release checklist and update the roadmap entry. :white_check_mark:
